channel.title: Benni OS // Sovereign AI Engineering & Architecture
channel.description: Frontier technical essays on Autonomous AI Agents, Zero-Trust Security, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Multi-Agent Swarms by Benni Alencar.

item.title: Cyber Sentinel: Hardening Autonomous AI Agents Against Prompt Injection and Secret Exfiltration
item.description: Implementing a Tier-0 Zero-Trust defense layer across 9 discrete execution checkpoints (POD-9), intercepting direct and indirect prompt injections in real time.
item.author: Benni Alencar

item.title: Control Plane OS: Durable State Orchestration and Infinite Loop Prevention for AI Agents
item.description: Architecting a centralized control plane for autonomous artificial intelligence agents with atomic snapshots, persistent graph memory, and continuous reconciliation.
item.author: Benni Alencar

item.title: Agent Armies: Coordinating Massive Multi-Agent Swarms with Typed Leases and Deterministic Handoffs
item.description: How to orchestrate dozens of specialized AI agents with deterministic state handoffs, strict token budget governance, and least-privilege role isolation in production.
item.author: Benni Alencar

item.title: Nemesis Gateway: The Enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) Blueprint for Tool Federation
item.description: Engineering blueprint for building sovereign, federated gateways on top of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) with real-time authorization policies and zero cloud lock-in.
item.author: Benni Alencar

item.title: Autonomous Swarm Consensus with Local Ollama Models: Zero-Cloud Cost Distributed AI Inference
item.description: Distributed consensus strategies and hybrid routing architectures to run entire autonomous agent swarms on local consumer hardware with zero cloud inference expenditure.
item.author: Benni Alencar

item.title: Project Adam: Recursive Self-Evolution and Algorithmic Prompt Optimization for AI Agents
item.description: Constructing self-improving feedback loops where autonomous agents critique their own execution logs, refine system prompts, and compile new workflow nodes without human intervention.
item.author: Benni Alencar

item.title: Deterministic Handoffs: Eliminating Context Drift in Multi-LLM Agent Pipelines
item.description: State transition patterns across heterogeneous language models to ensure downstream agents receive strictly schema-validated payloads without hallucinated assumptions.
item.author: Benni Alencar

item.title: Sovereign Serverless AI Backends with Puter.js: Zero Fixed Infrastructure Cost
item.description: Deploying browser-native and serverless AI microservices, persistent key-value storage, and decentralized authentication with Puter.js at zero fixed monthly operational overhead.
item.author: Benni Alencar

item.title: Autonomous Revenue Loop: Engineering Self-Optimizing Funnels and Automated AI Sales Operations
item.description: The system architecture analyzing acquisition metrics, adjusting messaging in real time, and orchestrating commercial deal closing with minimal manual intervention.
item.author: Benni Alencar

item.title: Spatial 3D & WebGL Shaders in Benni OS: 60 FPS Visual Interfaces for AI Topologies
item.description: Building immersive Three.js and GLSL spatial experiences that translate abstract multi-agent network topologies and real-time execution graphs into fluid 60 FPS visualizations.
item.author: Benni Alencar
